description: Single-panel heatmap: a dense rectangular plotting region filled with many small, equally sized rectangles arranged in a grid. Rectangles vary in color intensity and cover most of the central-left area of the canvas, leaving margins for axes and a right-side legend (ignored). No additional overlaid lines, areas, or connectors.

primary.explanation: Heatmap bins form a regular grid; approximately 30 columns along x.

secondary.explanation: Regular grid rows; approximately 25 bins along y.
